name: Osteofibrous Dysplasia
definition: Rare benign fibro-osseous lesion primarily involving the tibial cortex in children, with an important diagnostic relationship to adamantinoma.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI define cortical lesion; biopsy is reserved for atypical or aggressive cases and should be oncologically planned.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Observation for typical stable childhood lesions
amber: Aggressive or atypical lesions require exclusion of adamantinoma.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikriti phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Rare benign fibro-osseous lesion primarily involving the tibial cortex in children, with an important diagnostic relationship to adamantinoma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
